# Exact GW point-estimate benchmark (generated by run.py)

Every method on the same cases, seeds 0-4, 2 worker threads, same session. `gap` = best value over all runs of all methods for the case minus the run's value (nats); `hit` = gap < 0.01. Methods without `+polish` are the SGD part of the `+polish` run (value, seconds, evaluations before the L-BFGS-B polish). SGD: 8 starts = the multistart prior draws, 500 steps, cosine schedule to 1% of the rate, stop if the best improved < 1e-3 nats in 100 steps; `adam` lr 0.02 (sticks), `momentum` lr 0.01, `adam-logit` lr 0.1 in logit(stick), `adam-mb25` = Adam on 25% minibatches of clones per horizon. Polish: L-BFGS-B on the 4 best distinct endpoints.

## Minibatch cost and noise (two_type, generations 4/6/8/10, truth)

Median seconds of one call (Numba 2 threads). `law+jac` = the pgf recursion + FFTs alone (all horizons); minibatch steps differ from a full step only in the cell weights of the final dot product.

Gradient noise (40 minibatches): median |g_b - g| / |g| and median cosine between g_b and the full g, at the truth (near the MLE, small |g|) and half-way from the truth to the centre of the stick box.
